answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and detects coordinated equivocation through shared evidence. If k identities sign conflicting histories, aggregate penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), so collusion rapidly exhausts escrow. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to capital loss across the swarm, including asymmetric depreciation of linked stakes. A walnut marker, vertex attestations, and ferrous hardware signals may improve correlation without replacing cryptographic proof.
